speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Even as Singapore’s economy emerges from the COVID-19 pandemic, new challenges have surfaced.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) will step up efforts to grow Singapore’s economy, create good jobs and support businesses and workers in seizing new opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We can turn the challenges ahead into opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Through the way we managed the pandemic, we have proven to businesses and investors that we are reliable partners.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Government will continue to build on our strong fundamentals of efficient infrastructure, extensive connectivity, a highly skilled workforce, and an enabling policy environment, to capture growth opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Singapore must continue to remain open, expand our economic space and stay connected to global growth opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This strengthens our relevance as a global business hub and anchors high-value economic activities and good jobs here.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also strengthen our international partnerships to capture new opportunities, arising from Asia’s growth and global trends in digital trade and sustainability.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our growth strategies must be coupled with efforts to secure economic resilience amid heightened risk of global supply chain disruptions.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will help our industries capture opportunities in growth areas and support them in their transformation journey to become more productive and competitive.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will build a strong base of advanced manufacturing industries, including by leveraging technologies such as biotechnology and robotics.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Capitalising on global sustainability and digitalisation trends, we will strengthen Singapore’s position as a leading international green hub and seize opportunities in the digital economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also strengthen the nexus between research, innovation and commercialisation to enhance Singapore’s competitive advantage.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: At the same time, we will address our carbon, land, and manpower resource constraints.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will secure alternative forms of low-carbon energy and support enterprises to improve energy efficiency and reduce their carbon footprint.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will maximise the economic value from the use of industrial land and continue to attract global talent and rainmakers with skills that are complementary to our workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Thriving enterprises and an agile workforce are crucial to our next phase of growth.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will work closely with industry stakeholders to empower businesses to transform and workers to upskill to seize opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will deepen enterprises’ research and development capabilities and capacity for market-oriented innovation so they can respond more effectively to the changing operating context.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Enterprises will also receive support to develop capabilities in sustainability.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our people are the core of our economy.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will work with the Ministry of Manpower and Ministry of Education to equip our people with industry-relevant skillsets and ensure better alignment of training to industry needs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will focus our efforts to drive economic growth and create good jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will work with stakeholders to uplift enterprises and workers to capture opportunities and chart the path towards a prosperous and vibrant Singapore.
